content.description: Passport XYZ (aka Gitcoin Passport) verifies real human users to help networks mature by fostering trusted, long-term communities built around genuine participation. Its solutions are straightforward to integrate, featuring clear documentation and adaptable onboarding that fit projects at any stage. The platform provides tailored analysis, on-chain mechanisms to verify unique humanity, and industry-leading Unique Humanity Scoring, enabling ecosystems to measure authentic engagement and outcomes. These capabilities apply to all EVM-compatible ecosystems, regardless of development status, helping networks scale responsibly and sustainably.
